data.script: Maya: This is a practice test. Listen and write. … Maya: The school trip is on Thursday. Thursday, T-H-U-R-S-D-A-Y. … Maya: The bus leaves at nine fifteen. Nine one five. … Maya: Bring a packed lunch and a water bottle. The most important thing is the water bottle. … Maya: The entrance ticket costs seven soles. Seven. … Maya: And the teacher's phone number is nine-nine-two, three-four-five, six-seven-eight. … Maya: Now check your answers. You did it twice? Perfect. That's the exam way!

data.script: Look at the picture. Listen and write the names. There is one example. … Diego: Who is that in the school garden? The big black bird with a white collar. … Maya: That is Kili. Kili is carrying a letter. … Diego: And who is the girl in the green shirt with a magnifying glass? … Maya: That is Maya. Look, Maya is looking at something very small. … Diego: And who is the girl with long straight black hair and an orange shirt? … Maya: That is Aiko. Look, Aiko is reading a book. … Diego: And who is the girl with black plaits and a purple shirt? … Maya: That is Lia. Look, Lia is jumping with a skipping rope. … Diego: And who is the boy with red hair and a yellow shirt? … Maya: That is Oliver. Look, Oliver is singing.
